sqls.sql: WITH params AS ( SELECT #{plNos} AS plNos_param, #{equipmentNo} AS equipmentNo_param, #{stopReasonNames} AS stopReasonNames_param, #{startDate} AS startDate_param, #{endDate} AS endDate_param FROM DUAL ) SELECT p.plNos_param, p.equipmentNo_param, p.stopReasonNames_param, p.startDate_param, p.endDate_param FROM params p;
SELECT #{plNos} AS plNos_param, #{equipmentNo} AS equipmentNo_param, #{stopReasonNames} AS stopReasonNames_param, #{startDate} AS startDate_param, #{endDate} AS endDate_param FROM DUAL;

SELECT 'Simulated Reason' AS bkReasonName, 120 AS totalBreakTime, '10.50%' AS totalBreakTimeRate FROM DUAL WHERE #{plNos} IS NOT NULL AND #{equipmentNo} IS NOT NULL AND #{stopReasonNames} IS NOT NULL AND #{startDate} IS NOT NULL AND #{endDate} IS NOT NULL
